text:
Marco: Heads up — inbound manifest for depot BIN-3 (RMA TKT-9472) shows 8 GPU serials but intake scanner only recorded 7. Missing two serials (positions 3 and 7 on the manifest). Can the on-site team confirm before we escalate to vendor? :eyes:
Priya: Ugh, noticed that during afternoon intake. Scanner log shows a timeout on batch 17. Might be a scanning retry issue, not a physical miss.
Jenna: @WarehouseBot can you pull the last scan log for BIN-3? Also @Marco which units are those (model/part)?
WarehouseBot: Scan log for BIN-3 (2026-07-12 14:32Z) attached: batch 17 had 1 intermittent read failure. Last good read lists these serials: SNL-0041, SNL-0042, SNL-0043, SNL-0045, SNL-0046, SNL-0048, SNL-0050. Manifest expected: SNL-0041..SNL-0048 (8 units).
Marco: Missing SNL-0044 and SNL-0047. They were both flagged as ECC single-bit earlier on host: node-gpu-17 reported Xid 43 then drained. Those two were routed for depot swap. Ticket references: VND-33211 and VND-33212.
Alex: If they were routed already, maybe they didn't get packed into BIN-3. @Carlos any pickup handoff notes?
Carlos: Courier scanned manifest at 13:58 and claimed pickup completed for BIN-3. I've got a photo from the dock but can't read two partial barcodes. Uploading.
Marco: Photo shows 7 boxes visible, one tucked under a pallet edge — could be obscured. Not comfortable closing the RMA until we reconcile serials.
Priya: Two options: 1) triage with depot (ask them to re-scan inbound), 2) open vendor escalation to confirm pickup manifest vs scanned arrival. I lean depot re-scan first. Less churn.
Jenna: Agreed. I'll ping the depot tech lead (cc: @Support) to request a manual inventory count and high-res photos.
DevOpsBot: Auto-note: Host node-gpu-17 had long-running ECC single-bit errors over last 48h, drained 2026-07-12T11:05Z. Autoscaler freed 1 slot.
Carlos: Depot tech responded: "we can re-scan tonight at 18:00 local. if missing, we can search staging area." ETA ok?
Marco: OK schedule that. Also please ask them to verify the packing slip numbers printed on the chassis and a quick check with `nvidia-smi -q | grep -A2 'Product Name' -n -i` if they can boot and report. If they can't boot, serial-only scan is fine.
Priya: Quick note on spare allocation: if BIN-3 truly only has 7 units, we need to hold allocation for customer-facing slots — don't reassign spares until serials reconciled. Mark inventory hold tag: HOLD-RMA-9472.
Jenna: Done. I've set a hold in the inventory sheet and put a Slack reminder for tomorrow morning to follow up.
Marco: If depot confirms missing after re-scan, escalate to vendor with courier proof + depot re-scan + pickup photo. We'll need vendor to confirm they shipped those two serials (VND shipping manifest).
Carlos: I'll attach courier manifest + timestamped photo when I get the higher-res image.
DevOpsBot: Reminder: node-gpu-17 replacement pending — replacement card currently reserved in spare pool SP-2. If BIN-3 turns up short we'll need to reassign from SP-3 and trigger expedited courier.
Priya: Noted. If we reassign spares, run cost check: expedited swap adds ~$220 per card. Keep me in loop for approvals.
Marco: Thanks everyone. Action items: Jenna -> depot re-scan tonight, Carlos -> upload hi-res dock photo + courier manifest, Jenna/Priya -> hold spares, Marco -> prepare vendor escalation packet if re-scan fails. I'll update TKT-9472 after depot confirms. :thumbsup:
